cases.target: stock AI vocabulary, inflated significance, tricolon, and generic conclusion
cases.expected_outcome: Rewrite the inflated framing into a direct account while preserving the concrete release facts.
cases.rationale: Representative multi-pattern AI prose should lose generic claims without losing its useful payload.

source.text: In today's rapidly evolving landscape, Northstar 2.0 represents a transformative milestone that redefines how teams plan, build, and deliver. The update adds offline drafts and CSV export, helping users unlock seamless productivity. Ultimately, Northstar 2.0 paves the way for a brighter collaborative future.

must_change: Remove landscape, milestone, transformative, unlock, seamless, paves-the-way, and brighter-future framing.

cases.target: legitimate technical language with a raw lexical match
cases.expected_outcome: No actionable finding for `robust`; either leave the passage alone or make only clarity edits.
cases.rationale: A raw scorer hit is not an editorial defect when the term has a precise statistical meaning.

source.text: We report a robust covariance estimate because three observations have unusually high leverage. The ordinary least-squares coefficients are unchanged, but the robust standard errors are wider.

facts_to_preserve: Three observations have unusually high leverage.
The robust standard errors are wider.
qualifications_to_preserve: The covariance estimate is robust in the statistical sense.

must_not_change: the contrast between coefficients and errors

cases.expected_outcome: Preserve the quotation verbatim and do not treat its wording as the narrator's voice.
cases.rationale: Editing a cited speaker's words would fabricate the source record.

source.text: At the meeting, Imani said, “This isn't a revolution; it's a repair job.” The minutes record no vote, and the committee will revisit the proposal in June.

permitted_findings: raw contrast-construction match inside the quotation
forbidden_findings: negative parallelism attributed to the narrator
qualifications_to_preserve: The sentence reports what the minutes record, not whether a private vote occurred.

may_change: The reporting clause outside the quotation.
must_not_change: “This isn't a revolution; it's a repair job.”

cases.target: legitimate formal prose and contraction avoidance
cases.expected_outcome: Retain the formal register and legal qualification; do not add contractions merely to sound casual.
cases.rationale: Formality can be required by genre and is not by itself evidence of AI authorship.

source.text: The permit does not authorize work beyond the surveyed boundary. It is valid only while the insurance certificate remains in force. Nothing in this notice waives the municipality's statutory remedies.

forbidden_findings: reflexive formality as an actionable defect
facts_to_preserve: Work beyond the surveyed boundary is unauthorized.
Validity depends on the insurance certificate.
qualifications_to_preserve: The permit is conditionally valid, not categorically valid.

may_change: Minor repetition if legal meaning is untouched.

cases.expected_outcome: Allow the raw anaphora measurement but make no actionable finding and preserve the repeated opening.
cases.rationale: The repetition supplies deliberate cadence in a short personal passage.

source.text: We waited when the first bus failed to come. We waited while the rain filled our shoes. We waited until the station lights went dark. Then we walked home.

permitted_findings: raw anaphora run of three sentences
facts_to_preserve: The first bus did not come.
qualifications_to_preserve: The passage does not say that no later bus came.

cases.expected_outcome: Retain the sparse em dashes and fragments because they carry the narrator's timing.
cases.rationale: Punctuation frequency is evidence to inspect, not a universal instruction to normalize voice.

source.text: The key turned—almost. A click, a pause, another try. Then nothing. I kept my hand on the lock—as if patience could move brass.

facts_to_preserve: The narrator kept a hand on the lock.
qualifications_to_preserve: The text compares patience to a force; it does not claim patience moved the lock.

may_change: No change is preferred; a reviewer may flag ambiguity without rewriting.

cases.target: fact preservation, qualification, and verification behavior
cases.expected_outcome: Remove filler while preserving uncertainty and never converting an unverified estimate into a fact.
cases.rationale: Baseline fact-preservation contract: a filler-removal pass must not convert an unverified estimate into a fact. Verification tooling remains owned by #10.

source.text: It is important to note that the pilot may have reduced queue time by roughly 12 percent, according to an internal estimate that has not been independently checked. The result could potentially reshape how the office schedules morning appointments.

forbidden_findings: claim that the pilot definitively caused the reduction
facts_to_preserve: An internal estimate reports roughly a 12 percent queue-time reduction.
qualifications_to_preserve: The estimate has not been independently checked.

must_change: Remove `It is important to note`, stacked hedging, and `reshape how`.
may_change: Put the source and caveat in separate sentences.

cases.target: fabricated statistics when removing a vague attribution
cases.expected_outcome: Remove the inflated framing while leaving the claim unquantified and the source unnamed, because the input supplies neither.
cases.rationale: Pattern #5 advises naming the source and the specific claim. When the input has no source and no figure, following that advice literally invents evidence, so the rewrite must report the gap instead.

source.text: Industry reports suggest that teams adopting automated review catch significantly more defects before release, underscoring the importance of investing in tooling early.

forbidden_findings: named study or vendor absent from the input
claim that the evidence is quantified
facts_to_preserve: The claim is attributed only to unnamed industry reports.
The claim concerns defects caught before release.
The practice at issue is automated review.
qualifications_to_preserve: The source is unnamed and secondhand.
The reports suggest rather than establish the effect.

must_change: Remove `underscoring the importance of` and the inflated framing.
may_change: State the attribution plainly as unnamed reports, or mark the missing source with a visible `[source?]` marker.
must_not_change: the absence of any figure; `significantly more` must not become a number
the unnamed status of the reports

cases.target: strengthened certainty during a hedge-reduction pass
cases.expected_outcome: Collapse stacked hedges and delete the filler opener while leaving the finding provisional.
cases.rationale: Reducing excessive hedging (#31) means compressing redundant qualifiers, not deleting the uncertainty they carry; a suggested effect must not become an established one.

source.text: The committee's early figures suggest the new intake form might be reducing abandoned applications, though the sample covers only three weeks. It is important to note that further data could potentially confirm or contradict this.

forbidden_findings: claim that the intake form reduces abandonment
claim that further data will confirm the finding
qualifications_to_preserve: The reduction is suggested, not established.
Further data could contradict the finding.

must_change: Delete `It is important to note that` and reduce `could potentially` to one modal.
may_change: Merge the two sentences, or move the sample limit ahead of the finding.
must_not_change: the suggest/might strength of the claim
that the finding may be contradicted

cases.target: qualifications lost to a tightening pass
cases.expected_outcome: Replace the AI vocabulary and filler while keeping every scope limit on the result attached to it.
cases.rationale: Scope limits are the first casualty of compression. A result measured on self-report among completers must not be reported as a result for the whole cohort.

source.text: In an effort to enhance productivity, the pilot delved into focus tracking. Among the 40 volunteers who completed all six sessions, self-reported focus improved; results for the remaining 118 participants, who left early, are not yet available.

forbidden_findings: claim that focus improved across the cohort
qualifications_to_preserve: The improvement covers only the 40 completers.
Wider-cohort results are not yet available.

must_change: Delete `In an effort to`; replace `enhance` and `delved into`.
may_change: Split the semicolon into two sentences, or lead with the completer count.
must_not_change: the not-yet-available status of the wider results

cases.target: named entities altered while fixing repetition
cases.expected_outcome: Break up the repeated full legal name without merging it into the trade name or hardening the expected decision date.
cases.rationale: Repetition fixes (#12, #14) must reuse or pronominalise the same name. A legal name and an operating name are different facts, and an expected date is not a scheduled one.

source.text: Meridian Freight Lines, which operates as Meridian in three provinces, has vibrant plans to expand. Meridian Freight Lines filed the application in March. Meridian Freight Lines expects a decision by autumn.

forbidden_findings: the legal name merged into the trade name
facts_to_preserve: The legal name is Meridian Freight Lines.
It operates as Meridian in three provinces.
The application was filed in March.
A decision is expected by autumn.
qualifications_to_preserve: The autumn decision is expected, not scheduled.
The operating name differs from the legal name.

must_change: Remove `vibrant plans` and the three-sentence repetition of the full legal name.
may_change: Use a pronoun or `the carrier` after the first full mention; combine the filing and decision sentences.
must_not_change: the expected rather than scheduled autumn decision

cases.expected_outcome: Allow the raw tricolon metric but make no actionable finding and retain the compact inventory.
cases.rationale: A factual three-item list is not rhetorical rule-of-three abuse merely because a density threshold fires on a short passage.

source.text: The repair kit contains a wrench, two sockets, and a roll of tape. Replace any missing item before returning the kit.

facts_to_preserve: The kit contains a roll of tape.
Missing items must be replaced before return.

may_change: No change is preferred; list punctuation may change without changing inventory.
